title: Chapter 6726: The Rest Matters Not

Chapter 6726: The Rest Matters Not

Chapter 6726: The Rest Matters Not

“Do you know?” The person asked.

“No.” Li Qiye paused slightly before answering: “Do you?”

“Hard to say, never seen before.” The person said.

“Yes.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m sure you know that it’s either him or not him.” The person smiled.

“Not him, but it is. I don’t know him and have not met him.” Li Qiye smiled wryly.

“Isn’t that interesting? You and I have never seen him yet we know. He is right under our noses.” The person said.

“Yes, the character ‘hidden’ describes this perfectly.” Li Qiye said.

“Immortal Hunt Alliance has emerged, this is no secret and it surely exists.” The person continued.

“But not Hidden Immortal.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, no one saw the true body for sure.” The person said.

“It’s unfortunate.” Li Qiye smiled: “We don’t know anything yet Hidden Immortal knows us.”

“That’s alright. Our paths will cross since I’ll be at the end and ready to fight, not much more to think about.” The person said: “But it’s different for you, you want to flatten everything before departing.”

“Yes, I have to do it regardless of who or where.” Li Qiye said.

“Sounds like I won’t have an opportunity then.” The person smiled.

“Who knows, the answer will come soon enough as long as you maintain who you are.” Li Qiye said.

“Correct. I’m afraid I can’t help though.” The person said.

“It’s fine, we’ll both just have to take it in stride. If you die, I’ll handle it, and vice versa.” Li Qiye smiled, and the two drank from their cups again.

“What other moves will you make to bring stability?” The person asked.

“Only a few left now, the rest matters not.” Li Qiye said.

“Does that include Heaven Assault Alliance?” The person asked.

“Will you interfere?” Li Qiye asked.

“Although it originated from me, I don’t care for its prosperity. Do as you please.” The person said.

“Good, it’s decided then.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I do wonder what the brat Genesis is thinking. He is prideful and overconfident, thinking he deserves to reign.” The person smiled.

“Very ambitious.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, he believes he can predict the future, hence the confidence in always winning.” The person said.

“Is it true?” Li Qiye smirked.

“Not quite, there is still a long way to go. Though he views himself as a dragon capable of gauging us, it’s only an illusion.” The person said.

“We’ll see how much self-awareness he has, courting death or otherwise.” Li Qiye said.

“Currently, Heaven Assault is the strongest. Devour is near its end after your disciple killed Mang and the high heaven dealt with Zhao Dachui. You can handle the rest without issues.” The person said.

“Devour will try to hide to no avail.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What about the abjudicator? Will you allow his existence?” The person smiled.

“Old Golden? I trust him. All along, he has styled himself as the arbiter, upholding the balance and the heavenly scale.” Li Qiye said.

“So Golden Law Alliance will be fine to stay.” The person said.

“If you do become the high heaven, will you let them stick around?” Li Qiye asked.

“Yes, the mortal world has its judgment and scale. If someone wants to uphold it, might as well let him. Moreover, she didn’t deal with him during the sweep.” The person said.

“I suppose all the more reason to let him be.” Li Qiye said.

“So we have Guardian and Golden Law Alliance around, adding to the stability.” The person smiled.

“I’m sure you would not let Guardian stay around.” Li Qiye said.

“You’re incorrect. The world needs them even more in that case.” The person said.

“Right, the high heaven doesn’t permit their existence.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, hence your deal.” The person said.

“Just getting what we needed, that’s all. Nothing is better than the primordial will.” Li Qiye said.

“I must say, you and the high heaven worked well together.” The person said.

“What about us?” Li Qiye smiled.

“We aren’t working together, just like-minded individuals.” The person said.

“I suppose, I am leaving and you are entering the world, just like-minded individuals meeting each other.” Li Qiye said.

“What’s left for you is Heaven Essence and Immortal Hunt Alliance. Those two have been hiding after the sweep.” The person said.

“They’re all I need, I don’t care for the rest.” Li Qiye said.

“Octopus and Hidden Immortal.” The person said.

“How do we compare?” Li Qiye asked.

“Although you have not let go, you are ready. I’m sure you know my current state as well.” The person said.

“And you know mine.” Li Qiye said.

“As for the other two...” The person smiled.

“Octopus is real, as for Hidden Immortal.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“Octopus has deep ties with the villainous heaven.” The person remarked.

“We can deal with Octopus.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, either of us.” The person said: “The unknown is Hidden Immortal. If I have to bet, this being will not appear.”

“That would complicate things.” Li Qiye said.

“But you already know the answer, no need to ask me.” The person shook his head.

“I know that you have more information regarding Hidden Immortal than just guesses. The question is how you will deal with it.” The person said.

Li Qiye sighed upon hearing this.

“Others can’t but I believe you have caught on to the inconspicuous hints.” The person said seriously.
